buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Text Based ATC i . Bidders are required to submit EMD Rs. 1,00,027/- in favour of Munitions India Limited O. F. Khamaria. Exemption will be given to the sellers as defined at Para m of GeM GTC 4.0 (Version 1.28) dated 22.12.2025. or latest version o f GeM. Bidder should have registered in major NIC code “78” (Human resourc es provision and management of human resources functions) in Udyam Regist ration Certificate for EMD exemption. EMD/PSD may be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee from any of the commer cial banks and it should be drawn in the favor of CGM or payment online in an acceptable form and the same shall be uploaded by seller in the online bid an d hard copy of the same instrument (except online payment) will have to be s ubmitted directly to the buyer within following time limit: (#) Hard copy of the EMD (Bid security) will have to be submitted directly to the buyer within 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be tr eated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bid by buyer without makin g any reference to the seller. (#) Hard copy of the Performance security deposit (PSD) will have to be submit ted directly to the buyer within 30 days of award of contract on GeM Portal. It is advised that EMD may be submitted through online payment in favor of be neficiary details as given below to avoid postal delays & bank formalities asso ciated with generation and submission of instruments other than online payme nt. If the seller submits the EMD through online payment mode, then seller shal l upload the documentary proof of online payment of EMD along with online bid submission. Further it is also advised that PSD may be submitted through online payment mode after award of contract on GeM Portal in favor CGM, beneficiary details a s given below, and also Indemnity Bonds may be accepted as performance sec urity deposit from central/State PSUs. If seller submit the PSD through online p ayment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payme nt of PSD at GeM Portal. Account Name : Munitions India Limited O F Khamaria Account No. : 40436892598 IFSC : SBIN0003228 MICR : 482002006 Bank address : STATE BANK OF INDIA, RANJHI ii . In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e. ofkpvgrp8 @ord.gov.in OR call at 0761-2742137. i ii . For “Geographic Presence” Vendor has to submit GST Certificate with head office location in Jabalpur District. Firms who have not submitted the complete set of GST Certificate with head office in Jabalpur District, their offer will be rej ected. i v . Average annual turnover of the bidder for the last 03 years ending on 31st March of preceding year (2026) must be at least Rs. 10,00,278.15 lakhs. (MSEs & Startups are exempted). v ii . Bidders may submit latest copy of registration certificates of MSME certifica te along with bid. v i ii . Bidders should submit copy of registration certificates of EPF & ESIC along with bid. i x . Note to Bidders – Participating bidders may please be noted that GeM Po rtal is having functionality to monitor bids having same IP address used by bid ders / sellers. GeM portal is capturing and reflecting the IP address used by bu yers and participated bidders / sellers. The received bids having matching / co mmon IP address with other participating bidders / sellers or buyer, then their offer will be out rightly rejected and will not be considered for further evaluatio n. x . Bidders has to submit Near- relationship certificate that none of his/her relative is working in the Unit where he/she is going to bid for the tender. “The Bidder/Tender shall disclose whether any relative of the bidder /tenderer, it pr oprietor, partner director or person having a controlling or material interest in t he firm is employed with or associated with the procuring entity. Near relative shall mean a person related by blood, marriage or legal relationship, including spouse, father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister and such other relatives as may be specified under the applicable rules of the procuring entity. The Bid der/Tenderer shall submit a declaration conforming above. Any non-disclosure or incorrect declaration may be dealt with in accordance with the applicable te nder conditions and rules of procuring entity”. x i . Service provider have to follow recently implemented four labour codes eff ective from 21st November 2025. x ii . The person being deploy should have PVR (Police Verification Report) which is valid for 01 years. x i ii . The person being deploy having Adhar card linked with mobile no. x iv . Service Provider shall provide PPEs such & Uniform (colour of uniform shou ld be blue for Non filling area and orange for filling area and should have clear indication of working area and name of the firm in back side of uniform) to the manpower detailed and the contract value shall be including the cost of PPEs & Uniforms. x v . Firm should depute 10 nos. unskilled manpower on daily basis. Further the person being deployed shall be continued and should not be changed without prior permission of the buyer. x v i . Since GeM portal does not have the facility to feed exact 01 year experien ce for un-skilled labour, Hence the bidder must ensure minimum 01 year exper ience for 10 nos un-skilled labour as per scope of work /terms & conditions. xv ii . Bidders has to comply any other term & condition as mentioned in GeM SLA . xv i ii . Payment shall be made on monthly basis. Please refer point no 11 of clause

4.3 of Service Level Agreement. x ix . Performance Security Deposit (PSD) is to be furnished by the successful bi dder within 30 days after placement of contract. If the firm fails to submit the P SD within the specified date, it shall be treated as an unreliable firm and shall be governed as per existing guidelines on penalties issued by MoD/MIL/GeM. x x . Other Terms & Conditions will be applicable as per SLA of GeM for which th ese are not defined separately in ATC. x x i . Price Variation Clause is applicable. In case of any changes in the min imum wages as per the Applicable Laws during the Contract period, Buyer shal l pay the Service Provider the difference in wage from the amount mentioned i n the contract on pro rata basis. xx ii . Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the docume nts/certificates sought in the tender along with the bid. xx i ii . Also bidder has to arrange rain coat, umbrella, winter jacket etc. whenever required for his worker. No extra charge shall be claimed by service provider fo r these items. xx iv . Bidders has to timely pay salary to its worker i.e. on or before 7th of succe eding month. xx v . Bidder has to provide monthly salary slip and ID card to its worker. xx v i . If the workers are employed on national holiday, double salary on that day has to be paid by the contractor. xxv ii . Payment Terms :- 100% Payment will be made on monthly basis on submission of following docu ments- a. Satisfactory Job completion certificate issued by Site In-charge / Nodal Secti on. b. 100% payment toward government contribution of EPF and ESIC (wherever applicable) will be made on actual basis, on submission of EPF and ESIC cha llan along with copy of EPF and ESIC return and other relevant documents f or payment of ESIC contribution. Along with copy of challan a contribution h istory from ESIC web-site esic.in covering all the labourers in the contract is also to be attached along with contractor bill. c. Wage disbursement certificate that full amount has been disbursed to all th e employees including ESIC, EPF and Bonus. No amount has been recovere d from any of the employee thereafter. d. 100% GST will be reimbursed on submission of GST invoice along with relev ant documents. e. All the Penalties / Fine / Interest (if applicable) shall be settled before makin g the payments. xxv i ii . Penalty clause:- a. Penalty will be imposed in case the attendance goes below 90% on any wor king day. Penalty will be imposed after unsatisfactory certificate issued by t he C&H section and if the firm fails to perform satisfactory work as per chec k points in following manner:- i. Penalty will be imposed 1% of total value of contract of one working day for one deviation in each check points daily. Frequency of inspec tion and check points will be intimated to firm in writing (as per the work inspection frequency & scope of work) once the contract is awar ded. ii. Deviation noticed in the preceding inspection shall be rectified within a week. Follow up check for the rectification will be carried in the co ming week of Inspection. If no progress or a part has been rectified a cumulative penalty as per Penalty clause (i) will be amounted till the

complete deviations are rectified. If more than 10 deviations in a mon th then performance notice will be served to the firm. rd iii. If the firm gets 03 adverse performances notice, the contract may be short closed and the Security Deposit will be forfeited. b. PSD – The successful Tenderer will have to pay security deposit of 5% of to tal order value within 30 days of placement of contract. c. In case of unsatisfactory performance /services, the contract will be liable t o be terminated at any time giving 7 days notice and forfeiting the Security Deposit. In addition, a penalty up to 10% will also be levied, at the discretio n of the buyer. d. Buyer reserves the right to suspend/cancel the contract at any time without assigning any reasons. e. The AGENCY shall not appoint any sub-AGENCY for the work assigned to hi m. If subletting is noticed, the contract will be short closed forfeiting PSD (P erformance Security Deposit). xxxi. . Option Clause – The buyer reserves the right to increase/decrease the duration up to 50% at the time of placement of contract at the prevailing rate. The buyer also reserves the right to increase the duration by up to 50% durin g the currency of the contract at the prevailing rates. Bidders are bound to ac cept the orders accordingly. In case of multi L-1 offers, “Run L-1 Selection” tool provided by GeM system ma y be used and the contract will be awarded to GeM system selected L-1 firm with existing terms & conditions. . 3.
